source.note: common.md (Diagram detection): the first `%%{` starts no directive in the source; read once more with the line `%%{wrap}%%` left out, `%%{`, whitespace, and `x}%%` form a closed directive that detection skips, so detection reaches the header; the lexer then reads the characters of that directive as text, and the grammar rejects the input, as in mermaid.js.
